children: – Iran’s Civil Aviation Organisation has announced that Muscat International Airport will stop receiving Iranian flights from midnight on Wednesday, according to Iran’s Tasnim News Agency.
A spokesperson for the organisation said the suspension would take effect at 12 midnight local time. The announcement was made by the Iranian authorities and carried by Tasnim.
The spokesperson said Iranian authorities were also holding intensive consultations to reroute flights bound for Baghdad to Najaf International Airport.
Other international flights, including those to Istanbul, will continue to operate according to their regular schedules, with no changes at present, the spokesperson said.
He added that there were currently no obstacles affecting the operation of those flights.

title: ZAWYA: Muscat airport suspends Iranian flights
